carrier_primary.label: Carrier primary data
carrier_primary.note: Measured by the carrier for the actual movement: telemetry, verified fuel uplift, or a verified MRV return for the specific vessel and voyage.

verified_operator_avg.label: Verified operator average
verified_operator_avg.note: Derived by us from a statutorily verified per-ship dataset (EMSA THETIS-MRV) aggregated to operator and lane. Primary in ORIGIN, derived in computation, so it is our method over their measurement and both must be disclosed.

programme_lane_avg.label: Programme lane average
programme_lane_avg.note: A third-party programme's carrier-and-lane average (Clean Cargo is the intended occupant). LICENCE-GATED and EMPTY in v1: carrier-specific factors are members-only. The slot exists so connecting it later is an insert.

modal_default.label: Modal default factor
modal_default.note: An open-licence default by mode, vehicle class and fuel (UK DESNZ under OGL v3.0, US EPA public domain). THE v1 BASELINE. GLEC-conformant in method; the numbers come from sources we may lawfully re-serve.

proxy_estimate.label: Proxy estimate
proxy_estimate.note: A donor value from an adjacent mode, region or vehicle class. MUST name its donor. Never contractable, and never presented without its range.

movement.label: Specific movement
movement.note: One actual voyage or trip, measured. The tier-1 shape.

carrier_lane.label: Carrier on a lane
carrier_lane.note: A named carrier's average over a named corridor. The Clean Cargo shape.

operator_lane.label: Operator average
operator_lane.note: An operator's fleet average, optionally narrowed to a corridor. The THETIS-MRV shape.

modal.label: Modal default
modal.note: By mode, vehicle class, energy carrier and jurisdiction. The DESNZ/EPA shape, and all of v1.
